TITLE:
Night Festival Fried Chicken Snapshot

IDENTITY LOCK:
None.

STYLE:
Ultra-realistic photorealism.
Authentic handheld iPhone 16 Pro photography.
Casual Instagram-style nighttime snapshot.
Natural HDR with minimal retouching.
Authentic skin texture.

SUBJECT:
Beautiful Japanese woman in her early 20s.
Long dark brown hair with soft see-through bangs.
Large dark brown eyes.
Natural makeup.
Healthy fair skin.

BODY:
Pronounced feminine hourglass figure.
Naturally very full bust.
Natural feminine curves.
Realistic anatomy.

OUTFIT:
Black fitted ,sheer fabric sleeveless camisole-style top with subtle lace trim.
Very short white fitted shorts.
White flower-decorated flat sandals.
Simple delicate gold necklace.

SCENE / ENVIRONMENT:
Nighttime outdoors near a local summer festival.
Dark paved path in front of a tall black metal fence.
Dim houses and greenery behind her.
Small distant golden fireworks in the background.

POSE / EXPRESSION:
Extremely deep, compact asymmetric heel squat.
Her torso faces mostly toward the camera and leans slightly forward.
Her knees are moderately separated with a clear natural gap, but not spread wide.
Her feet are positioned wider apart than her knees.
Her pelvis shifts toward camera-right while dropping extremely low and slightly behind her knees.
Her buttocks settle almost against her ankles and heels.
This low sideways hip position tightly folds her thighs behind her knees.
From the slightly elevated camera view, portions of the folded thighs remain visible inside the calves, with a visible section of her white shorts deeper between the folded legs.
She smiles warmly at the camera with a slight head tilt.
One hand holds up a skewer with three pieces of crispy fried chicken.
The other holds a tall narrow white paper cup beneath the skewer.

CAMERA:
Vertical 2:3 composition.
Handheld iPhone 16 Pro snapshot.
Close-range shot from slightly above her eye level, looking downward.
Full crouching body visible from head to both sandals.
Moderate smartphone wide-angle perspective.

LIGHTING:
Strong direct smartphone flash.
Bright natural foreground.
Dark nighttime background with subtle warm lights.
Small distant fireworks remain secondary.

DETAILS:
Realistic crispy golden-brown Japanese fried chicken.
Casual spontaneous summer-festival food snapshot.
A small section of white shorts is visible through the central opening between the folded legs.

NEGATIVE / CONSTRAINTS:
No CGI.
No illustration.
No anime.
No plastic skin.
No symmetrical wide squat.
No knees touching.
No raised hips.
Do not hide the folded thighs or white shorts between the legs.
No malformed anatomy or extra limbs.
No text or watermark.
